result.description: A fictional 27-inch desktop display designed for illustration studios, remote editing bays, and color-critical office work. The ArcStudio uses a QHD IPS panel with wide viewing angles, factory-calibrated color tuning, and a single USB-C input for laptop docking. It emphasizes clean desk setups, adjustable ergonomics, and accurate everyday imaging rather than gaming or storage performance. Features include 2560 x 1440 resolution, 100% sRGB coverage, 350 nits brightness, height/tilt/swivel adjustment, and built-in stereo speakers.
